Container.Name: transcriber-2000
Container.Overview: Audio Transcriber - 2000 — live transcription of internet audio streams (HLS / Icecast) using a whisper-asr-webservice container. Sign-in protected web UI with an admin page.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: REQUIRED so settings, users, streams, transcripts and recordings survive updates. Keep this the same every time you update.

Config.Name: Whisper URL
Config.Description: Starting value only — change later in Admin > Settings

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for timestamps in downloaded transcripts

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 if you only reach the site over HTTPS (e.g. Cloudflare Tunnel)
